name: Academy
intro: Academy is SmartVideo's learning area, with fifteen tracks, sixty six lessons and seventy seven templates. Learn a skill here, then jump into a studio to make something.

features.hub-all-tracks: The hub is your starting point. It shows your overall progress, your bookmarks, and a grid of tracks. Click any track card to open it and see its lessons.
features.track-page: A track page lists its lessons on one side and its templates on the other, with a progress bar on top, so you can pick up right where you left off.
features.lesson-page-learn-tab: Every lesson opens on the Learn tab. Read the summary, or choose Read full lesson to load the whole text and the steps before you start creating.
features.lesson-page-see-tab: The See tab shows example images and videos from the lesson. Open one for a larger view and use the Try this button to send it to the right studio.
features.lesson-page-create-tab: The Create tab turns a lesson into something real. Open a linked template to build your deliverable, or launch a linked SmartVideo recipe where one is offered.
features.progress-tracking: Use the round check button on a lesson to mark it complete. Click it again to clear it. Your progress is saved in this browser.
features.bookmarks: Tap the star on a lesson to bookmark it for later. Bookmarked lessons are collected on the hub, ready whenever you want to return.
features.template-editor: Templates open in an editor with Create, See and Learn tabs. Show an example to see a good answer, then use Use Template to copy your work.

outro: That's Academy. Pick a track that matches your goal, work through a lesson, and turn it into a deliverable with a template.
